# External inputs

`county_table_project01.csv` holds the county columns this project uses from [Opportunity & Mobility Atlas](https://github.com/JonathanDoanePhD/opportunity-mobility-atlas) (its `output/county_table.csv`): FIPS, names, children 0-17 (ACS 2022), need index, priority flag, upward mobility (Opportunity Insights public-use release via Census) and economic connectedness (Social Capital Atlas, Chetty et al. 2022; Meta data license, attribution required).
